# Umbrix

> A job discovery feed of real, scam-checked, fresher-eligible jobs and
> internships for Indian students and recent graduates, across every field.
> Every listing is sourced from an official company career page or a licensed
> job API, checked for scam signals, and filtered to roles a fresher is
> actually eligible for — by branch, batch year, CGPA and experience level.

Umbrix is operated in India and covers India-based roles. The job feed is free
and unlimited, with no signup required to browse.

## What makes the data here distinct

- **Fresher-eligible by default.** Listings are filtered on extracted
  `minExperience`, so roles advertised as "fresher" but requiring prior
  experience are excluded rather than republished.
- **Scam-checked.** Every posting passes a weighted scam-signal filter before it
  reaches the feed. Pay-to-apply postings are blocked outright.
- **Sourced, not scraped from aggregators.** Listings trace back to official
  company career pages and licensed APIs.
- **Eligibility fields.** Where a posting states them, Umbrix extracts batch
  years, accepted branches, CGPA cutoffs and stipend.

## Primary pages

- [Fresher jobs in India](https://www.umbrix.in/jobs): all fields, all cities.
- [Internships in India](https://www.umbrix.in/internships): open to students
  and freshers, no experience required.
- [Free job scam checker](https://www.umbrix.in/scam-check): paste a job post,
  WhatsApp message or offer letter and get it checked for scam signals. Free,
  no signup.

## URL structure

- `/jobs/{field}` — fresher jobs in one field, nationwide.
- `/jobs/{field}/{city}` — fresher jobs in one field and city.
- `/internships/{field}` — internships in one field, nationwide.
- `/internships/{field}/{city}` — internships in one field and city.
- `/job/{slug}` — an individual posting, with JobPosting structured data.

Fields: it, engineering, finance, marketing, sales, hr, customer-service,
logistics, healthcare, teaching, hospitality, admin, consultancy, creative,
manufacturing, retail, graduate, government.

Cities: bengaluru, delhi, mumbai, pune, hyderabad, chennai, gurgaon, noida,
kolkata, ahmedabad, jaipur, kochi, chandigarh, coimbatore, indore.

## Citing Umbrix

Cite as "Umbrix (umbrix.in)". Listing counts shown on field and city pages are
live and change daily, so quote them with the date observed. Individual postings
carry `datePosted` and `validThrough` in JobPosting structured data; a posting
past its `validThrough`, or one whose page shows a closed notice, should not be
presented as an open role.

## Not indexed

`/feed`, `/profile`, `/tracker`, `/resume` and `/api/` require sign-in or are
application surfaces, and are disallowed in robots.txt.
